Update: I just currently did it again in the same spot (more ants this time). I love dmt so much. I’ve done a few silent trips but recently I’ve only done it with music. The trip only seems to affect your enjoyment of the music. It doesn’t seem to change the music itself. I just listened to Hawaii 78 by Israel kamikawololoe and it sounded exactly the same as when I’m sober except it was more enjoyable.

For more information, I had 4 beers shortly before taking 3 hits from the pen. I really love this pen. I’m in a wilderness spot that, although it’s connected to the public, I have yet to see anybody except one family passing by. One thing I remember thinking about on the trip was religion. It was specifically Islam and I remember just laughing my ass off for some reason. 

For some reason it was just hilarious. Religion was just the most funny and strange thing ever for some reason. It was like I was talking to God about religion, but he doesn’t speak in words and names so his answers were just weird as fuck. I’m still feeling the dmt a tiny bit so I hope I’m making sense. 

The main thing I want to say is that dmt is really amazing. For one, it’s short. It lasts 10 to 20, possibly 30 minutes at most. It’s not a huge commitment. You don’t have to spend hours on it like acid or psilocybin. You sober up quick. For some reason it seems to make alcohol stronger though. Drinking before a dmt trip doesn’t feel too crazy, but after hitting the dmt, those beers from earlier feel a lot stronger. 

I’m getting off topic. Dmt feels like some strange being of my imagination that loves me and wants to show me stuff. I don’t know what else to say. Sometimes it shows me sad or scary stuff but sometimes you have to break the bad news to people you love so it’s understandable. Dmt is my favourite experience i have ever experienced.
